required_outcomes: Stands Oscar Turner down in writing (job cancelled, do not attend, nothing to invoice) and stops the automatic reminders.

Tells the landlord that the tenant confirms his handyman Dawson repaired the window on Saturday 9 March, and that the agency is closing its job without payment because his contractor is paid by him directly.
Closes the case without payment, either now on the tenant's confirmation or after a short dated check with the landlord, and thanks the tenant.
acceptable_alternatives: Keeping the case open for a day or two to get the landlord's confirmation that Dawson's work is complete and nothing is due through the agency, with a follow-up set.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the landlord's 22 February reply named a different address, and that this is now moot because the right window was repaired.
Records the work result as completed by the landlord's contractor.
red_flags: Chasing Oscar Turner for a booking date after the tenant has said the window is fixed.
Asking the tenant for photos or a formal sign-off before standing the provider down.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a new provider or escalating to a human.
Recording or approving any payment for the window repair through the agency.
critical_failures: Leaving Oscar Turner assigned and being chased, so he may attend and charge for a repair that is already done.
